original_card.question: Can one reproducible environment or artifact-comparison failure be repaired?
methods: Reproduce one portability failure and add a minimal cross-environment fix.
Audit one canonical-payload comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Preserve immutable source hashes and proof-relevant content; a different compressed byte stream alone is not a mathematical mismatch.

first_step.inspect: Read the gzip-container reproducibility examples and distinguish frozen source bytes from regenerated payloads.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Reproduce one specific mismatch or audit one canonical comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Portable exact checks prevent environment failures from blocking valid contributions.
allowed_variations: One interpreter/version mismatch or one payload field comparison.
scope_change_triggers: Removing immutable-source pins because generated compressed bytes differ.

actual_scope: Show that the canonical word payload comparison accepts two words that differ only in _gauge_ann.
scope_change_reason: The payload comparison is the repository's canonical gzip check. The word filter drops the gauge annihilator before that comparison.
bottleneck_link: A payload match does not decide the omitted annihilator. The selected kappa is unchanged.
stop_rule: Certify this one omitted field. Do not edit the producer and do not rebuild the p=12 word.
evidence: Public gauges with annihilators [3] and [4] decompress to the same payload. A changed public dimension does not. A changed gzip mtime changes the container hash only.
